name: Sarah Rowden
quote: What used to take days now takes minutes.
paragraphs: Sarah first used AI to create detailed performing arts lesson plans. Work that previously took days of preparation could now be completed in minutes.
She now relies on Copilot for professional emails, spelling and grammar support, training creation, Excel learning and analysing how her time is spent across projects.

name: Mike Chatziminas
quote: AI changed the way I think.
paragraphs: Mike admits he was sceptical when AI first appeared and originally resisted using it.
After understanding what it could actually do, it became one of his favourite tools for research, learning, training creation and even planning holidays.

name: Amy Veall
quote: I use AI every single day.
paragraphs: At home, Amy uses AI for gardening projects and DIY guidance, helping save thousands of pounds.
At work, it generates engagement ideas, incentives, posters, communications and Excel solutions in minutes.

name: Katie Doran
quote: Sometimes you just need something explained differently.
paragraphs: Katie regularly uses AI to support coaching conversations and advisor development.
It helps simplify difficult topics and provides alternative approaches for objection handling and customer conversations.

name: Gary Rodgus
quote: It gives me more time for decisions, not data crunching.
paragraphs: Gary uses Copilot daily to analyse information, summarise reports and solve Excel challenges.
The time saved can instead be spent reviewing findings, debating insights and making stronger business decisions.

name: Abi Catterall
quote: Copilot saves me around two hours every day.
paragraphs: Abi uses Copilot to analyse data, build presentations and organise her workday.
Outside work, it helped her complete major DIY projects including a kitchen renovation and custom cupboards.

name: Oscar Taylor
quote: It lets me focus more on helping people.
paragraphs: Oscar uses Copilot to support complaint handling, draft communications and summarise complex discussions.
It helps turn information from multiple sources into clear, structured responses for customers.

name: Eleanor Whiteside
quote: Many of the designs became part of the final result.
paragraphs: When moving house, Eleanor used AI to visualise decorating ideas before spending money on renovations.
Design concepts, colour recommendations and styling ideas helped her make decorating decisions with confidence.

name: Katie Winstanley
quote: It helps me inspire, support and lead my team every day.
paragraphs: Katie relies on AI to streamline key management tasks, regularly using it to design eye-catching posters for team incentives.
It has also become an invaluable sounding board for crafting clear, impactful development plans and tailored objectives during 1:1 sessions.

name: George Winter
quote: It's like having a second pair of eyes on every customer conversation.
paragraphs: George uses AI-assisted call transcripts to quickly review customer interactions against agreed objectives and coaching points.
Instead of manually searching through long calls, he can focus on identifying strengths, opportunities and meaningful coaching conversations.

name: Jessica Ball
quote: Copilot helps me spend less time on admin and more time supporting people.
paragraphs: Jess regularly uses Copilot Premium to summarise meetings, translate conversations between languages and organise key discussion points.
It also helps her draft documents, review wording and explore best practice guidance, making it easier to create clear and consistent communications.

name: Taylor Anderton
quote: What once took an hour can now be reviewed in minutes.
paragraphs: Taylor uses AI-powered transcripts and summaries to support complaint handling and case reviews, helping quickly identify key themes and customer concerns.
By reducing the time spent searching through conversations, more time can be focused on delivering timely resolutions and improving the customer experience.

name: Ashley Ncube
quote: The insights help me make every coaching conversation more meaningful.
paragraphs: Ash uses AI to analyse coaching themes across multiple customer interactions, helping highlight common strengths, trends and development opportunities.
It also supports the creation of learning activities, quizzes and knowledge checks tailored to specific topics and coaching objectives.
